meta.name: ast-grep
meta.description: Searches and rewrites code by AST shape across 25 languages. Use when the target is a syntax pattern (every call/class/import shaped like X, a codemod, a YAML rule) rather than literal text; for plain strings, comments, or filenames, use rg.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按代码的语法结构搜索并批量重写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在大量文件里按语法结构统一改代码
copy.tagline_en: Search and rewrite code by its syntax structure, at scale
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to edit code by syntax pattern across many files

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按代码的语法结构来查找和改写代码,覆盖 25 种语言:比如找出所有某种形状的函数、调用、类、import,或把 console.log 批量换成 logger.info。改写默认只出预览,确认后才真正改文件。
howto.when: 当你要求按语法结构查改代码(如「找出所有接收 Request 参数的函数」「把 require 改成 import」),或运行 YAML 规则扫描时触发;查字符串、注释、文件名则改用 rg。

howto.what_en: Claude searches and rewrites code by syntactic shape across 25 languages: find every function, call, class or import shaped like X, or turn console.log into logger.info. Rewrites show a dry-run preview first; files change on confirmation.
howto.when_en: Trigger when the target is a syntax shape, not text — e.g. "find every function taking a Request param" or "migrate require() to import" — or when running YAML rules; use rg for strings or comments.

say_en.text: Use ast-grep to find every function that takes a Request parameter
say_en.note: Returns a list of match locations

say_en.text: Rewrite every console.log in src/ to logger.info
